svg.title: AI Helpdesk agent architecture
svg.desc: Agent architecture: one question runs through five stages in the agent runtime. The React 18 console posts it, and the answer streams back over SSE. 1 Understand, an intent vote typed with Pydantic 2, reading working memory from Redis 7. 2 Gather, tools picked by rules and run together with asyncio.gather: a search in PostgreSQL 16 with pgvector and tsvector, and a delegation over A2A to the peer agent ai-sql-agent, which runs its own loop; one corrective round when the evidence is thin. 3 Route, domain scores pick the specialists, and a monitor re-weights their replicas every 10 seconds. 4 Answer, three specialists through the Anthropic or OpenAI chat models, falling back to a generalist. 5 Check, a guard and three confidence gates; a failed gate hands off to a person with a ticket. The platform is FastAPI, Python 3.12, httpx, Docker Compose, Nginx, OpenTelemetry and Grafana. Pulses travel each connection in that order and the stage badges light up in turn.

circle.style: transform-box: view-box; transform-origin: 902px 335px; animation: spin 10s linear infinite
